info.name: Invoice Reservation — Program Capacity
info.description:
Every request in this collection asserts what it expects, so **Run collection** exercises the
whole service and reports pass/fail.

### Before you start

```bash
docker compose --profile app up -d --build --wait
```

Nothing else is needed:

- the collection mints its own bearer tokens from `jwtSecret`, which matches the secret the
  Docker stack runs with;
- it plays the treasury system itself: programs are published to the Kafka feed through
  Redpanda's HTTP proxy (`kafkaProxyUrl`), and the service opens them from the feed.

Requests run in order and share state — the Programs folder publishes a program with a fresh id
each run, and later requests reserve against it — so run the collection top to bottom rather
than one request in isolation.

### What it covers

- a program published by treasury over Kafka, and seen through the API once the feed applies it
- reserving capacity in the program currency and in another currency (FX conversion)
- partial and full repayments, including replays and misuse of a repayment id
- paging through reservations with a cursor
- every refusal: insufficient capacity, validation, 401, 403
- treasury raising the limit, and a periodic reconciliation
- treasury suspending the program (new reservations refused) and reactivating it
